This implies that *Eucalyptus gum* may modulate the activity of this calcium channel, potentially affecting the metabolic pathway involving *Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase*. The evidence is consistent with a regulatory role of *Eucalyptus gum* in the physiological processes that depend on this enzyme, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated. The integration of multiple targets and their shared involvement in metabolic pathways supports the hypothesis that *Eucalyptus gum* exerts its effects through a mechanism that indirectly influences the activity of *Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase*.
